content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for Madurai Kamaraj University Guest Faculty Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to submit the resume for the Madurai Kamaraj University Guest Faculty recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the resume for the Madurai Kamaraj University Guest Faculty recruitment is 13th August 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their resumes before this date.

faq.question: Q2. When is the Walk-in Interview scheduled for the Guest Faculty positions?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview for the Guest Faculty positions at Madurai Kamaraj University is scheduled for 14th August 2026. Ensure you reach the venue on time.

faq.question: Q3. What is the total number of vacancies for the Guest Faculty post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies for the Guest Faculty post at Madurai Kamaraj University.

faq.question: Q4. What are the essential qualifications required for the Guest Faculty role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a PG Degree in Computer Science / Computer Applications / Information Technology, and be UGC NET / SET Qualified or hold a Ph. D. in the concerned discipline.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for this recruitment. Both General/OBC and SC/ST categories are exempted from paying any fee.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly with their documents.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for these Guest Faculty positions?
faq.answer: The job type for these Guest Faculty positions is Contractual.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the Madurai Kamaraj University located?
faq.answer: Madurai Kamaraj University is located in Madurai, Tamil Nadu, with the pincode 625021.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: You should carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, and category certificate if applicable.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for the Guest Faculty recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves screening of resumes followed by a Walk-in Interview.
